crm_mapping: revenue/production_survival/crm.md stage 'Public pain captured': phrase plus source URL. Airtable base JOJO Revenue Recovery CRM is the system of record; this file is research input only, not a second CRM.

signals.pain_phrase: async tasks that silently freeze when the LLM call fails — no exception, no log, the process just hangs; cost me a full day of debugging
signals.who: Engineer running CrewAI in production for months; June 2026 Claude outages (4 in one month, 10% error rate on June 16) would each have triggered the freeze
signals.binary_test_fit: Given an async task whose LLM call fails, when the failure occurs, then the flow emits a visible failure and halts instead of hanging — exactly the stop-path the survival proof delivers
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should survive routine LLM API failures, but in production it silently freezes and downstream agents wait forever.
signals.contact_route_status: NONE — public GitHub issue exists; any contact is owner decision; cold pitch in a stranger's issue thread is spam-adjacent and NOT recommended

signals.pain_phrase: when the LLM call throws an exception in an async task, the flow freezes instead of failing gracefully; synchronous execution fails as expected
signals.who: Company developer behind a corporate proxy; production flow depends on async execution
signals.binary_test_fit: Given a litellm APIError inside an async task, when it throws, then the flow stops visibly with a receipt instead of freezing
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should fail loudly and roll back on provider errors, but in production the flow freezes and says nothing.
signals.contact_route_status: NONE — community forum account required; owner decision

signals.pain_phrase: all my local Cowork sessions have disappeared with no migration, no warning, and no recovery option — critical ongoing work sessions, client deliverables, hours of agentic work, simply gone; paying Pro user
signals.who: Paying Claude Pro subscriber with client deliverables destroyed by an app update; thread has multiple affected users
signals.binary_test_fit: Given a crashed or wiped agent session, when recovery runs, then the work state is restored with a durable receipt — the crash-resume evidence pattern
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should survive the harness crashing, but in production an update wiped months of sessions with no recovery path.
signals.contact_route_status: NONE — public issue thread; owner decision

signals.pain_phrase: the CEO agent was relaunching a fresh headless session every two seconds — the entire organization was headless, every other agent sat idle

signals.binary_test_fit: Given a compound failure (bad config + premature wake), when the loop starts, then a visible stop path fires before the fleet goes idle — their own postmortem shows the class
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should absorb a bad config write, but in production two minor bugs compounded into a 2-second relaunch loop that idled the whole fleet.
signals.contact_route_status: NONE — vendor-adjacent (they sell an agent platform); better as credibility citation than prospect; owner decision
